# Şebinkarahisar Belediyesi

> Official municipal portal for Şebinkarahisar providing civic services, announcements, events, and administrative information.

Şebinkarahisar Municipality (Şebinkarahisar Belediye Başkanlığı) serves the city of Şebinkarahisar in Giresun Province, Turkey. The site offers access to municipal government services, public notices, procurement announcements, and information about city infrastructure and cultural projects.

## Key Topics

- Şebinkarahisar Municipality
- Municipal Government
- Local Administration
- Public Announcements
- Municipal Projects
- City Infrastructure
- Kent Meydanı
- Şebinkarahisar Kent Müzesi
- Millet Bahçesi
- Municipal Council
- Public Procurement
- Municipal Events
- Giresun Province
- Institutional Profile
- Turkish Municipality

## Core Municipal Services

- [Şebinkarahisar Belediye Başkanlığı](https://sebinkarahisar.bel.tr): Şebinkarahisar Municipality main portal with civic services and announcements
- [Güncel Duyurular](https://sebinkarahisar.bel.tr/duyurular): Current municipal announcements and public notices from Şebinkarahisar
- [İletişim](https://sebinkarahisar.bel.tr/iletisim): Contact information and communication form for Şebinkarahisar Municipality

## Municipal Administration & Leadership

- [Başkan Özgeçmiş](https://sebinkarahisar.bel.tr/icerik/baskan-ozgecmis.html): Mayor biography and professional background of Şebinkarahisar
- [Meclis Üyeleri](https://sebinkarahisar.bel.tr/profil-kategori/meclis-uyeleri.html): Municipal council members and government structure
- [Müdürlerimiz](https://sebinkarahisar.bel.tr/profil-kategori/mudurlerimiz.html): Municipal directors and management personnel
- [Görev Yapmış Belediye Başkanlarımız](https://sebinkarahisar.bel.tr/icerik/gorev-yamis-belediye-baskanlarimiz.html): List of former mayors and municipal leadership history

## Institutional Information

- [Belediyemizin Tarihçesi](https://sebinkarahisar.bel.tr/icerik/belediyemizin-tarihcesi.html): History and background of Şebinkarahisar Municipality organization
- [Misyon-Vizyon-İlkeler](https://sebinkarahisar.bel.tr/icerik/misyon-vizyon-ilkeler.html): Mission, vision and principles of Şebinkarahisar Municipality

## Public Procurement & Tenders

- [Güncel İhaleler](https://sebinkarahisar.bel.tr/ihaleler.html): Current municipal tenders and public procurement announcements
- [Meclis Kararları](https://sebinkarahisar.bel.tr/meclis-kararlari.html): Municipal council decisions and administrative records

## Events & Community Activities

- [Etkinlikler](https://sebinkarahisar.bel.tr/etkinlikler): Municipal events and community activities in Şebinkarahisar
- [Güncel İlanlar](https://sebinkarahisar.bel.tr/ilanlar.html): Current listings and municipal job announcements

## Optional Resources

- [Foto Galeri](https://sebinkarahisar.bel.tr/foto-galeri): Photo gallery showcasing municipal projects and city infrastructure
- [Belediyemizin Logosu](https://sebinkarahisar.bel.tr/icerik/belediyemizin-logosu.html): Municipality logo and corporate identity information
